CAF.note: No link between the civil register and the ID system is stated.

facts.fact: The civil-status software MbetiNet, which records births, marriages and deaths, is being piloted at Bimbo commune's main civil-status centre, with teams deployed from 16 November 2026 under the EU-funded MODERO project run by CIVIPOL.

CAF.note: The ministry data centre named hosts only the ministry's own civil-status database; no data centre for hire is stated.
Only a unique number per civil act is stated, not an ID number given to a child at birth.
No connection of a local government office is stated; MbetiNet is an application.
The ministry data centre is not stated to rent to other organisations.

facts.fact: MbetiNet is in pilot at one commune civil-status centre, Bimbo, before any extension to other centres, per Les Autres Nouvelles de Centrafrique.
The pilot is run under the authority of the Ministry of Territorial Administration, Decentralisation and Local Development (MATDDL).
The pilot is supported by the European Union's MODERO project, implemented by CIVIPOL.
